parameters.query:
-- Route the message to its studio. `account_ref` is the account the lead
-- messaged (IG entry.id / Slack channel id), NOT the lead's own id.
--
-- LEFT JOINs from a one-row source so this ALWAYS returns exactly one row:
-- an unmatched account comes back with studio_found = false rather than an
-- empty result set (zero rows skipped every downstream node, including the
-- dead-letter branch built to catch exactly this case).
SELECT (s.id IS NOT NULL) AS studio_found,
       s.id  AS studio_id,
       s.name AS studio_name,
       s.timezone,
       s.prompt_vars,
       s.booking_url,
       s.owner_name,
       s.owner_alert_email,
       s.links_ok,
       ca.credential_ref
  FROM (SELECT 1) AS anchor
  LEFT JOIN channel_accounts ca
         ON ca.channel = $1 AND ca.account_ref = $2 AND ca.active
  LEFT JOIN studios s
         ON s.id = ca.studio_id AND s.active
 LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO dead_letters (workflow_id, execution_id, reason, payload, error)
VALUES ($1, $2, 'unknown_account', $3::jsonb, $4);

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$workflow.id, $execution.id, JSON.stringify($('When Called').first().json), 'No active channel_accounts row for channel=' + $('When Called').first().json.channel + ' account_ref=' + $('When Called').first().json.account_ref] }}

parameters.query:
-- Idempotent per (channel, external_id). The status CASE is the lifecycle:
--   cold/new  -> engaged   (a returning lead re-enters the funnel)
--   escalated -> escalated (stays with the human until they resolve it)
--   booked / link_sent     (kept: the conversation continues, the state stands)
-- and nothing moves at all while ai_paused is set.
WITH prev AS (   -- the row as it was before this message (empty for a new lead)
  SELECT pause_alerted_at FROM leads WHERE channel = $2 AND external_id = $1
)
INSERT INTO leads (external_id, channel, name, username, profile_checked_at, studio_id, status, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $5, CASE WHEN $6::boolean THEN now() END, $4, 'engaged', now(), now())
ON CONFLICT (channel, external_id) DO UPDATE SET
    name       = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.name, leads.name),
    username   = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.username, leads.username),
    profile_checked_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.profile_checked_at, leads.profile_checked_at),
    status     = CASE
                   WHEN leads.ai_paused                THEN leads.status
                   WHEN leads.status IN ('cold','new') THEN 'engaged'
                   ELSE leads.status
                 END,
    -- While paused, the owner hears "she wrote again" at most once per 12h
    -- (the takeover / escalation email itself sets this too).
    pause_alerted_at = CASE
                   WHEN leads.ai_paused AND (leads.pause_alerted_at IS NULL
                                             OR leads.pause_alerted_at < now() - interval '12 hours')
                   THEN now() ELSE leads.pause_alerted_at END,
    updated_at = now()
RETURNING id, status, ai_paused, username, name,
          (ai_paused AND ((SELECT pause_alerted_at FROM prev) IS NULL
                          OR (SELECT pause_alerted_at FROM prev) < now() - interval '12 hours')) AS pause_alert_due;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('When Called').first().json.external_id, $('When Called').first().json.channel, $('When Called').first().json.name || null, $('Resolve Studio').first().json.studio_id, $('When Called').first().json.username || null, !!$('When Called').first().json.profile_checked] }}

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO messages (lead_id, direction, channel, body, author, created_at)
VALUES ($1, 'inbound', $2, $3, 'lead', now());

-- Always exactly one row (scalar subqueries), even for a brand-new studio.
SELECT
  (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', c.id, 'name', c.name, 'weekday', c.weekday,
                                     'time', to_char(c.start_local, 'HH24:MI'),
                                     'minutes', c.duration_minutes, 'level', c.level,
                                     'url', c.booking_url)
                   ORDER BY c.weekday, c.start_local)
     FROM studio_classes c WHERE c.studio_id = $1 AND c.active)                AS classes,
  (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', o.id, 'kind', o.kind, 'name', o.name, 'price', o.price,
                                     'currency', o.currency, 'details', o.details, 'url', o.url,
                                     'for_new_clients', o.for_new_clients)
                   ORDER BY o.sort_order, o.id)
     FROM studio_offers o WHERE o.studio_id = $1 AND o.active)                  AS offers,
  -- The real conversation (staff replies included once auto-pause logs them),
  -- replacing n8n's separate chat memory. Newest 20, returned oldest-first.
  (SELECT json_agg(t ORDER BY t.created_at)
     FROM (SELECT direction, author, body, created_at FROM messages
            WHERE lead_id = $2 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20) t)            AS thread,
  (SELECT count(*) FROM messages WHERE lead_id = $2 AND direction = 'outbound') AS outbound_count;

WITH link AS (
  INSERT INTO booking_links (lead_id, studio_id, class_id, kind, target_url, short_code)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6)
  RETURNING id
)
UPDATE leads SET status = CASE WHEN status IN ('booked', 'escalated') THEN status ELSE 'link_sent' END,
                 updated_at = now()
 WHERE id = $1
RETURNING (SELECT id FROM link) AS booking_link_id;

-- One statement (a parameterised query can't hold two): mark the latest
-- link as booked-by-the-lead, then the lead.
WITH latest AS (
  UPDATE booking_links SET lead_said_booked_at = COALESCE(lead_said_booked_at, now())
   WHERE id = (SELECT id FROM booking_links WHERE lead_id = $1 ORDER BY sent_at DESC LIMIT 1)
  RETURNING id
)
UPDATE leads SET status = 'booked', updated_at = now()
 WHERE id = $1
RETURNING (SELECT id FROM latest) AS booking_link_id;

WITH e AS (
  INSERT INTO escalations (lead_id, reason, resolved, created_at)
  VALUES ($1, $2, false, now())
  RETURNING id
)
-- Escalating PAUSES the AI for this lead until the owner taps Resume: the
-- owner email says it has stepped back, and now it really has.
UPDATE leads SET status = 'escalated', ai_paused = true, paused_by = 'escalation',
                 paused_at = now(), pause_alerted_at = now(), updated_at = now()
 WHERE id = $1
RETURNING (SELECT id FROM e) AS escalation_id;
